name: Blizzard
primary:
A snowstorm covers an area 11 blocks across around the aimed spot. Chunks of ice and snow rain down from the sky and shatter on impact without leaving blocks.
Ultimate channel: just stand still for up to 12 s. Stepping aside breaks the channel; instant mode does not apply. Needs open sky: at least 10 blocks of air above the target, so it fails in caves and under roofs.
Once a second, everyone in the storm takes:
• Damage 1.5 ❤ cold
• Cold 50: slows, freezes solid at 100 accumulated cold
• Chill for 3 s
Each falling chunk hits within 1.5 blocks:
• Damage 3 ❤ cold
• Strong chill for 4 s
• Freezes solid for 1.5 s
self_description:
On you:
• Stone skin (resistance III), 15 s
• Cold 60
